description: This file defines a command-line interface (CLI) command for initializing a new agent project within the AgentField framework. It includes interactive prompts for project configuration, templates for project scaffolding, validation utilities, and integration with Cobra and Bubble Tea for command handling and user interaction.

classes.name: initModel
classes.description: Represents the state of the interactive initialization flow, including current step, user inputs, choices, and status flags.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the Bubble Tea model, here returning nil as no initial command.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Handles incoming messages and updates the state accordingly, including keyboard input for navigation and text entry.

methods.name: View
methods.description: Renders the current UI screen based on the model's state, displaying prompts, choices, and errors.

methods.name: handleEnter
methods.description: Processes the user pressing Enter, validating input, advancing steps, or finalizing the setup.
